# Connector Readiness Audit

Agentic research over 100 SaaS apps for Composio toolkit buildability, with a prioritized build-and-outreach queue and honest, gold-scored accuracy.

Status: partial (34/100) (run run-100).

## Headline
- 34 apps audited; 17 already Composio toolkits (lower bound (partial catalog source)).
- 24 can ship this week with zero approvals.
- 0 need outreach/approval — start those now (long lead times).
- 0 are not toolkits (no API / wrong shape).
- 6 routed to human review; 19 have first-party MCP.
